title: Pastor Sonny and Ma’am Mila’s Wedding Anniversary
place: Faithway Bible Baptist Church, Puerto Princesa City
sum: The church family gathered to celebrate Pastor Sonny and Ma’am Mila’s wedding anniversary. “O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: because his mercy endureth for ever.” (Psalm 118:1)

sum: Three days of preaching, worship and outdoor activities for our young people.

sum: Celebrating the students who completed this term’s Bible lessons.
